Isotonic solutions must have the same

(B) Density
(C) Elevation in boiling point

Density and solute identity do not have to be identical for isotonic solutions.
Density is a physical property that varies independently of isotonicity.

solution.quick: Isotonic solutions have equal osmotic pressure (π = CRT), meaning they have the same molar concentration, hence identical colligative properties like elevation in boiling point (ΔTb) and depression in freezing point (ΔTf).
solution.concept: Two solutions having same osmotic pressure at a given temperature are called isotonic solutions.
